response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior engineer with a strong web/full-stack background, but the profile is a poor match for this embedded security firmware role. There is no Japanese language ability listed (native-level Japanese is a hard requirement), no Linux kernel source-level work, no networking security experience (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching, chip SDKs), and only brief C/C++ exposure over a decade ago at National Instruments. The core stack is JavaScript/TypeScript, D, and Node.js rather than C for UNIX embedded systems. Despite solid engineering craft and testing discipline, the gap against the mandatory qualifications is too wide to justify an interview.
strengths: 15+ years of software development experience with senior/staff-level roles
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, test tooling authorship, and open-source contributions
Some low-level and systems exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux, C++ audio/wave-field-synthesis project)
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed, while native-level Japanese is a hard requirement
No Linux kernel analysis/modification, embedded firmware, or switch/chip-vendor SDK experience
No security-domain experience (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal, encryption) or L2/L3 networking background; C work is minimal and over 10 years old

key_factors.factor: No networking or security domain expertise
